headline: Mercury General Corporation Reports Third Quarter Results and Dividend
summary: Mercury General Corporation reported its consolidated financial results for the third quarter of 2026 and declared a quarterly dividend.
why: Mercury General Corporation is an insurance holding company operating primarily in writing personal automobile and homeowners insurance.
